content.short: Ormi Labs builds optimized on-chain data pipeline solutions that reduce cost and complexity for developers handling blockchain data on Mantle.
content.description: Ormi Labs specializes in on-chain data infrastructure, providing optimized data pipeline solutions for developers who need to efficiently process and react to blockchain events. The platform reduces the complexity and cost of building custom data indexers by offering pre-built pipelines and streaming data services tailored for high-throughput blockchain environments. Deployed on Mantle, Ormi Labs helps ecosystem developers efficiently handle the on-chain data generated by the network's growing DeFi activity.
content.meta: Ormi Labs provides optimized on-chain data pipeline solutions for developers building on Mantle. Discover Ormi Labs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
